title: Blessings in Sustenance and Longevity
summary: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) advised maintaining family ties for blessings.
translation: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said, 'If you desire blessings in your sustenance and long life, you must do one thing. If a person performs it, Allah will grant them both blessings. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said, whoever wants abundance and blessings in their sustenance and a long life should maintain family ties, fulfilling the rights of relatives and recognizing these as responsibilities. Ensure that these ties are upheld, not letting them end with the passing of a relative. Continue to maintain each relationship according to its rights, and as a result, blessings and longevity will be granted.'
